CLASSIFICATION: correctly transmission/gas -- described everywhere (ICRA, GSPL AR, PNGRB) as a cross-country natural-gas transmission trunk, common-carrier authorized; existing Fuel/PipelineType refs (pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/data-bank.html#bm7) already resolve live. DUPLICATE: NOT a double-count. P5411 (Phase II, construction, 763 km) and P0941 (Phase I, operating, 1177 km) are a legitimate phased split of ONE PNGRB authorization -- 'Mehsana -Bhatinda', partially_commissioned sno 1 in the repo's May-2026 register crosswalk (batches/india-gas/staging/register-crosswalk/pngrb_ngpl_mis.json + register_crosswalk.json, both already reason=PHASED_PAIR) -- the same legitimate pattern as the Mallavaram-Bhopal reference case in the country guidance, not the Barauni-Guwahati-style embedded-section double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner split (GSPL 52% / IOC 26% / BPCL 11% / HPCL 11%) independently confirmed exact-match by ICRA's rating rationale for GIGL ('joint-venture between Gujarat State Petronet Ltd (52%), Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (26%), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (11%) and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (11%)') and corroborated for GSPL's own 52% stake in GSPL's FY2019-20 Annual Report subsidiary table ('GSPL India Gasnet Limited ... Subsidiary Company 52'). StartLocation=Mehsana/Gujarat and EndLocation=Bhatinda/Punjab confirmed by the same PNGRB authorization letter and by PNGRB's Dec-2025 progress report, which lists the pipeline as passing through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab. validity.researcher_notes: Both LengthKnown (763.00 km) and Capacity (80.11 MMSCMD) on this row are stale, not fabricated -- they read exactly as a mid-2022-vintage PNGRB snapshot, not the current one. Independently verified: PNGRB's Dec-31-2025 NGPL report (pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/20251231_NGPL.pdf, fetched and read with pdftotext -layout) lists 'Mehsana - Bhatinda / GIGL / 07.07.2011 / 1,943 [authorised length] / 83.11 [capacity MMSCMD] / 1,318 [operating length] / 624 [under-construction length] / June 2026 [target]'. The repo's already-reconciled May-2026 register crosswalk (pngrb_ngpl_mis.json, sno 1, partially_commissioned) shows the same authorization at operating=1339 km / under_construction=604 km / authorised+determined capacity=83.1 MMSCMD. Both dated editions therefore materially disagree with the sheet's 763 km / 80.11 MMSCMD on this Phase-II row -- capacity by ~3.6% (80.11 vs 83.1) and the construction remainder by ~18-21% (763 vs 604-624). A web synthesis independently pointed to an earlier PNGRB edition (NGPL-23052022.pdf) as the origin of the '80.11 MMSCMD' figure, and the corresponding 1177/763 operating/under-construction split (matching the sheet's current P0941/P5411 values) traces to a similar ~2023 vintage -- i.e. this is the country's documented sectional-commissioning pattern (guidance trap #3): sections keep moving from 'under construction' to 'operating' as the network is built out, so a length/capacity pair frozen at an earlier authorization edition goes stale even though Status itself ('construction') is still the right bucket. Per the country guidance this is presumptively a stale earlier-edition figure, not a unit error, so I did not overwrite it myself -- flagging for Update with the current sourced values above rather than silently filling a ref onto an unsupported number.
